title: Testing for Unobserved Heterogeneity in Censored Duration Models: EM Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.36824v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ignoring unobserved heterogeneity in duration models biases parameter estimates and invalidates inference, but testing for it is non-regular: the null hypothesis lies on the boundary of the parameter space and some parameters are unidentified under the null. These features render standard asymptotic theory inapplicable. This paper develops an EM test for unobserved heterogeneity in censored Weibull duration models, building on the EM approach of Li, Chen, and Marriott (2009). The test statistic has an asymptotic null distribution equal to the square of max{0, N(0,1)}, hence critical values require neither simulation nor bootstrap, and the test accommodates covariate-dependent censoring of arbitrary form. Monte Carlo simulations compare the EM test with the likelihood ratio test (LRT) of Cho and White (2010), information matrix tests, and Lagrange multiplier tests. The EM test has empirical size close to the nominal level for sample sizes

translated_title: 删失持续模型中不可观测异质性的检验：EM方法
translated_abstract: 在持续（久期）模型中忽略不可观测的异质性会导致参数估计有偏并使推断失效，但对其进行检验属于非正则问题：原假设位于参数空间的边界上，且某些参数在原假设下不可识别，这些特点使得标准的渐近理论不再适用。本文在Li、Chen和Marriott（2009）的EM方法基础上，针对删失Weibull（威布尔）持续模型中的不可观测异质性提出了一个EM检验。该检验统计量的渐近原假设分布等于 max{0, N(0,1)} 的平方，因此临界值既不需要模拟也不需要自助法（bootstrap），并且该检验允许任意形式的协变量依赖删失。蒙特卡洛模拟将EM检验与Cho和White（2010）的似然比检验（LRT）、信息矩阵检验以及拉格朗日乘数检验进行了比较。在给定样本量下，EM检验的经验规模接近名义水平。
tldr: 本文针对删失Weibull持续模型中不可观测异质性检验这一非正则难题，提出了一种EM检验，其原假设下渐近分布为max{0, N(0,1)}的平方，无需模拟或bootstrap即可确定临界值，且能兼容任意形式的协变量依赖删失。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an EM test for unobserved heterogeneity in censored Weibull duration models — a non-regular testing problem — whose asymptotic null distribution is the square of max{0, N(0,1)}, requiring neither simulation nor bootstrap for critical values, and which accommodates arbitrary forms of covariate-dependent censoring.
